extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated prior mechanism locator notes against primary XML/prose and figure images without promoting pathway association to direct target proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BmKDfsin3 inhibits HCV replication in Huh7.5.1 cells under noncytotoxic concentrations; this is antiviral phenotype/activity evidence and is represented in the activity layer, not as a direct molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BmKDfsin3 against HCV J399EM in Huh7.5.1 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: IC50/CC50 and concentration-response support antiviral/cytotoxicity phenotype, not a direct binding mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Mode-of-treatment data support effects at viral attachment and post-entry stages, while free-virion and entry/fusion stages were not significant in the local source.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BmKDfsin3 mode-of-treatment assays in HCV-infected Huh7.5.1 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure 2/source text support stage association and percent effects; they do not identify a direct viral or host molecular target for BmKDfsin3.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BmKDfsin3 suppresses p38 phosphorylation in HCV-infected and TNF-alpha/IL-1beta/LPS-stimulated Huh7.5.1 cells, and His-BmKDfsin3 enters cells in the confocal assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports p38 pathway modulation and cell entry, but it does not prove a direct BmKDfsin3 binding target in the p38 cascade.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Independent inhibition of upstream MyD88/IRAK-p38 signaling by ST2345 and IRAK-1/4 inhibitor I suppresses HCV replication, supporting p38-pathway relevance to infection.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ST2345 and IRAK-1/4 inhibitor I comparator experiments in HCV-infected Huh7.5.1 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Comparator inhibitor data support p38 pathway involvement in HCV replication; they should not be curated as BmKDfsin3-specific potency values.
